wake-of-gods.mapobjects.altar-of-transfo: Altar of Transformation

Once per week. With 100 spell points, choose a destination. A free random destination is offered when eligible; if it is the only offer, transformation is automatic. Ineligible troops remain unchanged.

{Altar of Transformation}

You climb to the top of the altar but the energy merely sputters around you as if it had recently been drained. Try again next week.

{Altar of Transformation}

None of your troops can be transformed by the available magic. No spell points are spent.

{Altar of Transformation}

Destination: Castle. 100 spell points.

Attracted by the magical energies, the life essence
of your troops fly towards the altar. 

They whirl around for a while in a giant lightning
storm and finally they consolidate themselves into 
other shapes again.
